user.title: Vacuum Map
user.description: Draws the maps of your Roborock vacuums, read from the Roborock integration, in the Vacuum Map card. Nothing to enter.

abort.no_roborock: Set up the Roborock integration first.

init.title: Live map
init.description: How often the robot and its path are read while it cleans on the local network. The rooms and walls are read again in full when a cleaning starts.

data_description.live_interval: 1 s by default. Each reading is a local request to the vacuum, never through the cloud; the next one waits for the previous one to finish.
